title: How to calculate a ratio like 16:9
task: Reduce two numbers to their simplest ratio — aspect ratios, mixes, staffing.
explanation: GCD finds the greatest common divisor (120 for 1920 and 1080); dividing both numbers by it reduces the pair to lowest terms, and & glues them with a colon: "16:9". For a "1 : n" style ratio instead, divide through by the first number: ="1:"&ROUND(B2/A2,2) gives 1:0.56. The result is text — keep the raw numbers in their own cells if you still need to calculate with them.
